articles.title: Launch HN: Versine (YC F26) – MCP to send and receive money
articles.summary: Hey HN, we’re Harshith, Param, and Vishnu and we're building Versine ( https://versine.com ). Versine lets you send and request money just by talking or texting with your AI (think Venmo with an MCP). We’re software engineers who have worked on distributed systems at Stripe, Databricks, and Amazon. Versine is an MCP that sits in front of a wallet with a balance. articles.title: Show HN: Brickie – Deploy sandboxes in your own AWS account
articles.summary: Hey HN, this is Alexander from Hatchet ( https://github.com/hatchet-dev/hatchet ). We’re releasing a new open-source project today called Brickie. Brickie lets you run sandboxes in your own cloud account, primarily targeting EKS on AWS. Sandboxes are an incredibly useful primitive for agentic applications. They serve two main functions: (1) a way for the agent to safely execute untrusted code, and (2) a durable filesystem for agents to preserve their state via snapshots.
